entities.summary: St Aloysius Church is a Roman Catholic parish church in the Garnethill area of Glasgow in Scotland. It is the only church in Glasgow to be run by the Society of Jesus. It is situated on the corner of Hill Street and Rose Street and is next door to St Aloysius' College, Glasgow, having a close relationship with the school. When it was built, it was the only Catholic church in Glasgow to have a tower. It is modelled on Namur Cathedral in Belgium and is a Category A listed building. St Aloysius Church is a church building in Europe, established in 1910-02-06. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
